name: YEAR_MONTH
description: Year and month as 'YYYY-MM' (since March 2025). One value per file

name: REGIONAL_OFFICE_NAME
description: NHS England region; 'UNIDENTIFIED' for the national unidentified rows

name: REGIONAL_OFFICE_CODE
description: Region code (Y56 to Y63); '-' for the national unidentified rows

name: ICB_NAME
description: Integrated Care Board of the commissioner or provider, as at the month

name: ICB_CODE
description: ICB code: 3 characters, or 5 for the ICBs created in April 2026; '-' when unknown

name: PCO_NAME
description: Primary care organisation: sub-ICB location, NHS trust, council or other provider

name: PCO_CODE
description: Primary care organisation code

name: PRACTICE_NAME
description: Prescribing organisation: GP practice, out-of-hours service, trust department and others; not unique

name: PRACTICE_CODE
description: Prescribing organisation code, 6 characters; '-' for the national unidentified rows. The key

name: ADDRESS_1
description: Address line 1; empty string when unknown

name: ADDRESS_2
description: Address line 2; often empty

name: ADDRESS_3
description: Address line 3; often empty

name: ADDRESS_4
description: Address line 4; often empty

name: POSTCODE
description: Postcode; empty string when unknown

name: BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE_CODE
description: Chemical substance code: 9 characters, or 4 for appliance chapters 20 to 23

name: BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE
description: Chemical substance name, or appliance type (a code before March 2025)

name: BNF_PRESENTATION_CODE
description: BNF presentation code: 15 characters, or 11 for appliance chapters 20 to 23

name: BNF_PRESENTATION_NAME
description: Presentation: name, strength and form, or appliance type

name: BNF_CHAPTER_PLUS_CODE
description: BNF chapter number and name, for example '05: Infections'

name: QUANTITY
description: Quantity per item (part of the source grain); summed away on load

name: ITEMS
description: Number of prescription items; whole numbers, at least 1

name: TOTAL_QUANTITY
description: QUANTITY x ITEMS, in the presentation's own unit; up to 2 decimals

name: ADQ_USAGE
description: Average daily quantities supplied; 0 means no ADQ is defined (loaded as NULL); up to 5 decimals

name: NIC
description: Net ingredient cost in pounds; at most 2 decimals

name: ACTUAL_COST
description: Actual cost in pounds; up to 5 decimals

name: UNIDENTIFIED
description: 'Y' for prescriptions not attributable to a practice ('UNIDENTIFIED DOCTORS'), else 'N'

name: SNOMED_CODE
description: dm+d product code (13 to 17 digits; empty for 'Exception Handler' items). Part of the source grain; summed away on load
